rules.title: Primary Actions Must Be Explicit
rules.summary: Task-oriented screens should expose a clear primary action or review step rather than leaving the user with an inert surface.
signals: screen lacks an obvious action marker
screen reads like a passive data dump
action affordance is absent from the route entry point

rules.title: Loading, Empty, and Error States Must Be Represented
rules.summary: Screens that load remote or derived data should account for loading, empty, and error states in the local implementation shape.

rules.title: Screen Role and Navigation Context Must Be Clear
rules.summary: Route entry points should carry a clear screen heading, title, or navigation cue so the user can orient quickly.
signals: route entry point lacks title or heading marker
screen has no breadcrumb or nav cue
screen role is unclear from the top-level component

patterns.title: Workspace Page Template
patterns.summary: Use when a route combines list content, selection, actions, and explicit loading, empty, and error states under one stable heading.

patterns.title: Review Flow Template
patterns.summary: Use when a user needs to inspect an item, understand its state, and take one of a small number of explicit next-step actions.
